article.summary_es: Esta iglesia en Brooklyn aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos. La despensa funciona el primer y tercer jueves del mes.
article.summary_en: This Brooklyn church is listed on the City's Food Help NYC map as a food pantry. The pantry runs on the 1st and 3rd Thursday of the month.
how_they_help_es: Aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos.
Está ubicada en 2059 Bedford Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11226.

how_they_help_en: Listed on the Food Help NYC map as a food pantry.
Located at 2059 Bedford Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11226.
The pantry runs on the 1st and 3rd Thursday of the month only.
You can call (929) 340-4778 to ask questions.
